data_sources_valid_dates_check.name: data_sources_valid_dates_check
data_sources_valid_dates_check.value: "data_sources"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "data_sources"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "data_sources"."valid_to" >= "data_sources"."valid_from"

indicator_values_value_quality_check.name: indicator_values_value_quality_check
indicator_values_value_quality_check.value:
(
        "indicator_values"."value" IS NOT NULL
        AND "indicator_values"."quality_status" IN ('verified', 'provisional', 'stale')
      ) OR (
        "indicator_values"."value" IS NULL
        AND "indicator_values"."quality_status" IN ('missing', 'suppressed', 'conflicting')
      )

indicator_values_confidence_check.name: indicator_values_confidence_check
indicator_values_confidence_check.value:
(
        "indicator_values"."confidence_low" IS NULL AND "indicator_values"."confidence_high" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "indicator_values"."confidence_low" IS NOT NULL
        AND "indicator_values"."confidence_high" IS NOT NULL
        AND "indicator_values"."confidence_low" >= 0
        AND "indicator_values"."confidence_low" <= "indicator_values"."confidence_high"
        AND "indicator_values"."confidence_high" <= 100
      )

score_runs_output_hash_check.name: score_runs_output_hash_check
score_runs_output_hash_check.value:
(
        "score_runs"."status" IN ('validated', 'published', 'superseded')
        AND "score_runs"."output_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "score_runs"."output_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      ) OR (
        "score_runs"."status" IN ('draft', 'failed')
        AND "score_runs"."output_hash" IS NULL
      )

score_runs_completion_check.name: score_runs_completion_check
score_runs_completion_check.value: ("score_runs"."status" = 'draft' AND "score_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("score_runs"."status" <> 'draft' AND "score_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

score_runs_failure_metadata_check.name: score_runs_failure_metadata_check
score_runs_failure_metadata_check.value: ("score_runs"."status" = 'failed' AND "score_runs"."failure_metadata" IS NOT NULL) OR ("score_runs"."status" <> 'failed' AND "score_runs"."failure_metadata" IS NULL)

score_runs_validation_result_check.name: score_runs_validation_result_check
score_runs_validation_result_check.value: "score_runs"."status" NOT IN ('validated', 'published', 'superseded') OR "score_runs"."validation_result" IS NOT NULL

scores_numeric_range_check.name: scores_numeric_range_check
scores_numeric_range_check.value:
("scores"."demographic_score" IS NULL OR "scores"."demographic_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("scores"."socioeconomic_score" IS NULL OR "scores"."socioeconomic_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("scores"."health_score" IS NULL OR "scores"."health_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("scores"."composite_score" IS NULL OR "scores"."composite_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("scores"."equity_baseline_percentile" IS NULL OR "scores"."equity_baseline_percentile" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

scores_output_quality_check.name: scores_output_quality_check
scores_output_quality_check.value:
(
        "scores"."quality_status" = 'complete'
        AND "scores"."demographic_score" IS NOT NULL
        AND "scores"."socioeconomic_score" IS NOT NULL
        AND "scores"."health_score" IS NOT NULL
        AND "scores"."composite_score" IS NOT NULL
        AND "scores"."equity_baseline_percentile" IS NOT NULL
        AND "scores"."equity_baseline_band" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "scores"."quality_status" IN ('insufficient_data', 'ineligible_zero_population')
        AND "scores"."demographic_score" IS NULL
        AND "scores"."socioeconomic_score" IS NULL
        AND "scores"."health_score" IS NULL
        AND "scores"."composite_score" IS NULL
        AND "scores"."equity_baseline_percentile" IS NULL
        AND "scores"."equity_baseline_band" IS NULL
      )

food_access_metric_values_value_state_ch.name: food_access_metric_values_value_state_check

food_access_metric_values_quality_check.name: food_access_metric_values_quality_check

food_resource_versions_coordinate_check.name: food_resource_versions_coordinate_check
food_resource_versions_coordinate_check.value:
(
        "food_resource_versions"."coordinate_status" IN ('source_coordinate', 'authoritative_geocode', 'manually_verified')
        AND "food_resource_versions"."geometry" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "food_resource_versions"."coordinate_status" IN ('invalid', 'missing')
        AND "food_resource_versions"."geometry" IS NULL
      )

food_resource_versions_classification_ch.name: food_resource_versions_classification_check
food_resource_versions_classification_ch.value:
(
        "food_resource_versions"."full_service_grocery" = true
        AND "food_resource_versions"."category" = 'full_service_grocery'
        AND "food_resource_versions"."verification_status" IN ('verified', 'override_verified')
      ) OR (
        "food_resource_versions"."full_service_grocery" = false
        AND "food_resource_versions"."category" <> 'full_service_grocery'
      )

food_resource_versions_valid_dates_check.name: food_resource_versions_valid_dates_check
food_resource_versions_valid_dates_check.value: "food_resource_versions"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "food_resource_versions"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "food_resource_versions"."valid_to" >= "food_resource_versions"."valid_from"

food_resource_versions_verified_at_check.name: food_resource_versions_verified_at_check
food_resource_versions_verified_at_check.value: "food_resource_versions"."verification_status" NOT IN ('verified', 'override_verified', 'verified_context') OR "food_resource_versions"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL

food_score_runs_output_hash_check.name: food_score_runs_output_hash_check
food_score_runs_output_hash_check.value:
(
        "food_score_runs"."status" = 'validated'
        AND "food_score_runs"."output_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "food_score_runs"."output_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      ) OR (
        "food_score_runs"."status" IN ('draft', 'failed')
        AND "food_score_runs"."output_hash" IS NULL
      )

food_score_runs_completion_check.name: food_score_runs_completion_check
food_score_runs_completion_check.value: ("food_score_runs"."status" = 'draft' AND "food_score_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("food_score_runs"."status" IN ('validated', 'failed') AND "food_score_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

food_score_runs_failure_metadata_check.name: food_score_runs_failure_metadata_check
food_score_runs_failure_metadata_check.value: ("food_score_runs"."status" = 'failed' AND "food_score_runs"."failure_metadata" IS NOT NULL) OR ("food_score_runs"."status" <> 'failed' AND "food_score_runs"."failure_metadata" IS NULL)

food_scores_numeric_range_check.name: food_scores_numeric_range_check
food_scores_numeric_range_check.value:
("food_scores"."retail_access_score" IS NULL OR "food_scores"."retail_access_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("food_scores"."transportation_constraint_score" IS NULL OR "food_scores"."transportation_constraint_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("food_scores"."raw_food_access_need" IS NULL OR "food_scores"."raw_food_access_need" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("food_scores"."food_access_need_percentile" IS NULL OR "food_scores"."food_access_need_percentile" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

food_scores_output_quality_check.name: food_scores_output_quality_check
food_scores_output_quality_check.value:
(
        "food_scores"."quality_status" = 'complete'
        AND "food_scores"."retail_access_score" IS NOT NULL
        AND "food_scores"."transportation_constraint_score" IS NOT NULL
        AND "food_scores"."raw_food_access_need" IS NOT NULL
        AND "food_scores"."food_access_need_percentile" IS NOT NULL
        AND "food_scores"."food_access_need_band" IS NOT NULL
        AND "food_scores"."equity_baseline_band" IS NOT NULL
        AND "food_scores"."priority" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "food_scores"."quality_status" = 'insufficient_data'
        AND "food_scores"."retail_access_score" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."transportation_constraint_score" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."raw_food_access_need" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."food_access_need_percentile" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."food_access_need_band" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."priority" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "food_scores"."quality_status" = 'ineligible_zero_population'
        AND "food_scores"."retail_access_score" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."transportation_constraint_score" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."raw_food_access_need" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."food_access_need_percentile" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."food_access_need_band" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."equity_baseline_band" IS NULL
        AND "food_scores"."priority" IS NULL
      )
